day.headline: A Snake day — Ox and Rooster are in step.

reasons: Ox and Snake share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Halved it wrong, made twice too much. Feed someone tonight.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Thin at the elbows, still the best thing you own. Wear it.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You've said it four times already today. Say it again, unbothered.

reasons: Rooster and Snake share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: something in the freezer since spring
signs.message: That bag from March in the freezer. Thaw it, cook tonight.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Third run at that opening line. This one's fine, keep going.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: She's never once asked. Clock it, don't build a case.

reasons: Monkey pairs with Snake — a harmonious day
signs.motif: the noise you only hear at night
signs.message: Find the source of that 2am hum before dinner.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the calendar invite with no agenda
signs.message: Half an hour booked, no reason given. Ask what for.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: That side-by-side in your head helps nobody. Quit running it.

reasons: Snake's own day — your energy runs high
signs.motif: the jacket bought for a different life
signs.message: Bought for a version of you who goes out. Let it hang.

reasons: Pig opposes Snake — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: a coin found in a coat
signs.message: Change in an old pocket. Leave it, stay where you are.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Snake — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: They owe you nothing. Let that make today pleasantly small.
